subject.title: feat(config): add separate base URLs for summary and embedding models

question: Should gitcrawl establish both purpose-specific endpoint contracts now even though the summary endpoint has no current runtime consumer?
rationale: Code review cannot determine whether maintainers want to support a speculative summary configuration contract or prefer configuration to follow implemented functionality.

options.title: Narrow to embeddings
options.body: Land embed_base_url with live request proof and defer summary_base_url until summary functionality exists.

options.title: Sponsor both endpoints
options.body: Accept both fields now as an intentional forward-compatible contract and require endpoint-routing proof for embeddings before merge.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep the shared endpoint as the only supported path until both model purposes have active runtime consumers.

recommendation.title: Narrow to embeddings
recommendation.body: Land embed_base_url with live request proof and defer summary_base_url until summary functionality exists.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent substantial ownership of the central CLI file makes them the strongest available person to decide the configuration boundary.
